Prize Overview

Grand Prize 
"Work Exemption Certificate": Congratulations! As of today, you have earned yourself a lifetime of unpaid leave!

First Prize
"Ascension Voucher": Upon use, you will be granted a one-on-one meeting with Madam Pearl. The conversation is limited to 30 minutes, so make the most of this opportunity to move up the social ladder.

Second Prize
"Empty Layoff List": This list can be applied to any employee below the P30 rank, forcing them to pack their bags and leave within three days. This is a single-use item. Please select your target with caution.

Third Prize
"Efficiency Boost Bundle": Includes a "Forced Wake-up Alarm," an "EEG Monitor," and an "Electric Shock Smart Chair" to assist users in maximizing their productivity.

Fourth Prize
"Collaboration Artbook": A limited-edition artbook produced in collaboration with the Daybreak Squadron VFX film. While in high demand on the market, the item contains special encoding and resale is strictly prohibited.

Fifth Prize
"Mechatron Capsule Set": A classic collection of mechatron capsule giftboxes produced by Pearluxe, featuring the full lineup of models from the Transrebars series.

Participation Prize
"Thank You Box": Contains a "Deluxe Edition Employee Handbook," 10 cafeteria vouchers, and 3 paid sick leave application forms.
